description: This file defines the 'OAuthRefreshToken' entity class for the OrangeHRM project, mapping to the 'ohrm_oauth2_refresh_token' database table. It manages properties and methods related to OAuth refresh tokens, including token values, expiry, and revoked status, utilizing Doctrine ORM annotations.

classes.name: OAuthRefreshToken
classes.description: Entity class representing OAuth 2.0 refresh tokens within the OrangeHRM system, with properties for token strings, expiry timestamp, and status, including getters and setters for each property.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the refresh token.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the refresh token.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves the associated access token string.

methods.name: setAccessToken
methods.description: Sets the associated access token string.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the token expiry date/time as a DateTimeImmutable object in UTC.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry date/time of the token.

methods.name: isRevoked
methods.description: Checks if the refresh token has been revoked.

methods.name: setRevoked
methods.description: Marks the token as revoked or active.
